items.title: Meta's Muse is an impressively capable AI agent, despite some hiccups
items.summary: Here's what it's like to use Meta's Muse AI agent.

items.title: How Meta's Muse is driving a magic moment for the stock market
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his thoughts on the impact of Meta's (META) Muse AI agent on the broader stock market.

items.title: Meta’s Muse is a game changer—but can it win consumers' trust?
items.summary: The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Jake Conley, and Pras Subramanian discuss how Meta's (META) new AI agent, Muse, could pose challenges to user trust and why being first may not be enough, as rivals like Apple (AAPL) and Google (GOOG) could prepare their own responses.

items.title: Meta’s new AI agent just got me $250 in flight credits
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen recounts how Muse, Meta's (META) new AI agent, helped get him $250 in flight credits and rebooked a new flight after his original flight was delayed, demonstrating how users can now interact with an agent that handles web-based tasks on their behalf and shifts the role of the operational driver from human to AI.

items.title: Amazon blocks Meta's Muse but Shopify opens the door
items.summary: Two of retail’s biggest names just took opposite bets on AI shopping agents, and only one stock is moving on it.

items.title: Meta’s “10 Million Paid Users” Problem Has a Simple Solution
items.summary: Meta Platforms (META) has a problem: The narrative right now is built around AI…but AI isn’t actually generating any meaningful revenue for the company. Case in point: Muse, Meta’s new AI agent, just became the #1 free app on the Apple and Google app stores, sending shares soaring 11% on Monday.

items.title: Intel Falls 2.24% as Muse Keeps the CPU Thesis Alive
items.summary: Persistent agents add orchestration work, but Meta disclosed neither Intel hardware nor a purchase commitment.

items.title: Muse AI Is Already Forcing Tough Choices for Retailers. Amazon Isn’t Immune.
items.summary: Meta Platforms  may have the first breakout winner with consumers in its Muse AI agent.  If it keeps up the momentum, Muse is going to force website owners to make some difficult decisions about how much access they are willing to allow it, if any.  Personal agents released earlier this year like OpenClaw proved too complex for most people.
